maria: CI red on nightly-linux: unit test `retry_window_test` popped nondeterministic failure in 1/50 runs. attaching failing assert and the job link.

maria: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4598 :eyes:

ci-bot: Build #4598 failed on linux-x86_64 (unit). failing test: retry_window_test

sam: I'll grab a local repro. Do we have the failing seed / args from the job? logs show `seed=4271` in the test output?

maria: yes the log shows `seed=4271`. snippet:
```
thread 'retry_window_test' panicked at 'assertion failed: expected 3 retries, got 4', src/runtime/retry.rs:142
seed=4271
```

jon: this smells like ordering nondet when the fake timer and retry backoff interplay. I hit something similar last week on macOS.

lee: quick sanity: can you rerun with `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1` and `--test-threads=1`? Also try `--repeat 100` (`cargo test --test retry_tests -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 --repeat 100`). if it reproduces reliably we can bisect.

maria: running that now locally. If it reproduces I'll invoke `tools/seed-sweep.sh --start=4000 --end=4500 --parallel=8` and post results.

build-bot: re-run queued: CI re-run #4598. started on linux-x86_64.

sam: if you get a repro, paste core stack or `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` output. Also try `TEST_SCHEDULER=deterministic` env — it forced ordering for me in a past flake.

maria: got one reproduce within ~70 runs locally with seed=4271. posting backtrace shortly. kicking off seed-sweep next and will drop findings here — thanks :thumbsup:
